authority.scope: provider-controlled pricing, entitlement, access-policy and authorization evidence
authority.rule: Provider evidence may classify provider-controlled facts, but it does not invent AIPS prices, availability, delivery promises, refunds or customer claims. Unknown provider facts remain unknown.

shared_access_governance.explicit_allow_rule: A shared or multi-user commerce record may be published only when current first-party provider evidence or a provider agreement explicitly permits the exact access model and AIPS delivery/resale arrangement. Silence, team collaboration features, multiple-device login, owner approval, historical operation, or absence of enforcement are not authorization.
shared_access_governance.route_preservation_rule: If a shared-only product family would otherwise disappear, retain a neutral informational identity page with price/access/order claims removed. If a compliant non-shared sibling exists, exclude the unresolved shared row and preserve the family through the non-shared sibling.
shared_access_governance.note: Provider-by-provider evidence enrichment can continue without exposing unresolved shared commerce. Re-enabling any shared record requires an explicit allow entry backed by current first-party evidence or a provider agreement.

sources.finding: OpenAI states that an account is meant for the individual who created it and that another person should create their own account.

sources.fact_scope: ChatGPT Plus base subscription price and provider-controlled feature/limit variability
sources.finding: ChatGPT Plus is listed by OpenAI at USD 20 per month; model availability and usage limits can change and should be checked for the account/plan.

public_catalog_controls.reason: Current OpenAI first-party guidance says an account is for the individual who created it. AIPS shared-account records therefore must not be published as current sellable OpenAI access while this guidance applies.

commerce_implication.note: Approved-commerce projection must exclude OpenAI shared-access source rows and shared nested plans while preserving compliant personal/non-shared OpenAI options and the underlying raw audit record.

sources.finding: Perplexity says sharing an account violates its Terms of Use and risks suspension or termination.

public_catalog_controls.reason: Current Perplexity first-party guidance states that account sharing violates its Terms of Use.

sources.fact_scope: single-user account and resale/redistribution of service access
sources.finding: Midjourney states that only one user may use the Services per registered account and that users may not resell or redistribute the Services or access to the Service.

public_catalog_controls.reason: Current Midjourney first-party terms require one user per registered account and prohibit resale or redistribution of service access.

review_queue.priority: Evidence enrichment and exact-plan re-enable review only; unresolved shared commerce is already fail-closed.
review_queue.rule: Each provider re-enable review must use current first-party terms, policy, pricing or help-center evidence where available. Do not infer authorization from silence.
